# herccia

Perform the data tasks for a StriveTogether Civic Infrastructure
Assessment. Initially, this package focuses on public data from the [US
Census](https://api.census.gov/data/2020/acs.html), Wisconsin’s
[Department of Public
Instruction](https://dpi.wi.gov/wisedash/download-files), and internal
data from [Racine Unified School District](https://www.rusd.org).

## Installation

You can install the development version of herccia from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("higherX4Racine/herccia")
```

# Package index

## General utilities for the Civic Infrastructure Assessment

These functions and data tables are used for putting data into the CIA
format, and for mapping labels from their origins’ terms to the terms
used by StriveTogether.

- [`load_partnerships()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/load_partnerships.md)
  : Load JSON descriptions of StriveTogether partnerships

### Glossaries

Tables that map from one set of definitions to another.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_CIA`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_CIA.md)
  : The literal row labels for different populations that StriveTogether
  wants
- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_COMPS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_COMPS.md)
  : Group population and gender classes into three comparsions for
  visualization
- [`success_subtotals()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/success_subtotals.md)
  : Count up successes and failures based upon
- [`to_wide_cia_format()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/to_wide_cia_format.md)
  : Reformat a long data frame into the CIA format

### Census variables

The American Community Survey contains information about post-secondary
attainment and family-sustaining employment, in addition to general
counts of populations.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_CENSUS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_CENSUS.md)
  : Mapping from Census demographic categories to StriveTogether ones
- [`INCOME_BRACKETS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/INCOME_BRACKETS.md)
  : Mapping from Census income brackets to dollar values
- [`POSTSECONDARY_BY_LANGUAGE`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/POSTSECONDARY_BY_LANGUAGE.md)
  : Variables from the US Census to describe postsecondary completion by
  language spoken
- [`POSTSECONDARY_BY_POVERTY`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/POSTSECONDARY_BY_POVERTY.md)
  : Variables from the US Census to describe postsecondary completion by
  poverty status
- [`POSTSECONDARY_BY_SEX_AND_RACE`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/POSTSECONDARY_BY_SEX_AND_RACE.md)
  : Variables from the US Census to describe postsecondary completion by
  sex and race/ethnicity
- [`POSTSECONDARY_EDUCATION_LEVELS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/POSTSECONDARY_EDUCATION_LEVELS.md)
  : Values of education levels from the US Census to describe
  postsecondary completion

### IPEDS utilities

The US Department of Education has an Integrated Postsecondary Education
Database System. These tools help with wrangling those data.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_IPEDS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_IPEDS.md)
  : Mapping from IPEDS populations to StriveTogether ones
- [`SEMI_JOINS_FOR_IPEDS`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/SEMI_JOINS_FOR_IPEDS.md)
  : IPEDS fields for calculating 150% graduation counts
- [`wrangle_ipeds_graduates()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/wrangle_ipeds_graduates.md)
  : Wrangle raw IPEDS graduation data for local schools into the local
  150% postsecondary completion rate

### Wisconsin-specific utilities

Definitions and algorithms for converting Wisconsin data into CIA
format.

- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_WISEDASH`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_WISEDASH.md)
  : Mapping between WISEDash Public's "GROUP_BY_VALUE" and
  StriveTogether's "population."
- [`GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_OF_POPS_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL.md)
  : A mapping from WISEDash Local labels to StriveTogether ones.
- [`predicate_MAP_growth()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/predicate_MAP_growth.md)
  : Identify which students met or exceeded their MAP growth goals
- [`predicate_MAP_percentile()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/predicate_MAP_percentile.md)
  : Identify which students met or exceeded their MAP growth goals
- [`SEMI_JOINS_FOR_FORWARD`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/SEMI_JOINS_FOR_FORWARD.md)
  : Use this to semi-join Forward results and only get Strive-relevant
  data
- [`SEMI_JOINS_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/SEMI_JOINS_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL.md)
  : A lookup table for mapping demographic information from WISEDash
  Local to StriveTogether formats
- [`SPEC_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL_MAP_GROWTH`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/SPEC_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL_MAP_GROWTH.md)
  : Column specification for data from WISEDash about student growth in
  MAP scores
- [`SPEC_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL_MAP_PERCENTILES`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/SPEC_FOR_WISEDASH_LOCAL_MAP_PERCENTILES.md)
  : Column specification for data from WISEDash about student MAP
  percentile scores
- [`map_growth_for_k8()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/map_growth_for_k8.md)
  : Import and wrangle WISEDash Local data about students' growth on MAP
  reading
- [`map_percentiles_for_kg()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/map_percentiles_for_kg.md)
  : Import and wrangle WISEDash Local data about Kindergartners'
  percentile scores on MAP reading
- [`read_wisedash_local()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/read_wisedash_local.md)
  : Import data from WISEDash Local into a CIA-friendly format
- [`wisedash_local_to_strive()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/wisedash_local_to_strive.md)
  : Compute marginal totals for the CIA from student-level data from
  WISEDash Local
- [`wisedash_public_to_strive()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/wisedash_public_to_strive.md)
  : Wrangle WISEDash Public data into a format ready for the CIA
- [`wrangle_wisedash_local()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/wrangle_wisedash_local.md)
  : Wrangle data from WISEDash Local into a CIA-friendly format

### Utilities for income and family-sustaining wages

Definitions and algorithms for computing who is earning 300% or more of
the Federal poverty level.

- [`GLOSSARY_FOR_ACS_EMPLOYMENT`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/GLOSSARY_FOR_ACS_EMPLOYMENT.md)
  : Explain Census variables in terms of Sustainable Wage calculations
- [`fetch_acs_employment()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/fetch_acs_employment.md)
  : Pull one year of data about household income and populations by sex
  and race
- [`wrangle_acs_employment()`](https://higherx4racine.github.io/herccia/reference/wrangle_acs_employment.md)
  : Estimate the number of people living in a household with a
  family-sustaining income
